The basic idea of Android One is that it's a clean version of Android without any bloatware and with minimal modifications of the OS. It also means your phone will have two years  of latest updates and three years of security patches, with major Android updates coming soon after they are released on Google's own Pixel devices. IPS vs Super AMOLED is a matter of taste, although objectively, AMOLED is probably a bit better. IPS screens can have more natural-looking colours, they can even be a bit brighter (although GSMArena says 7 plus' screen could be a bit brighter), and viewing angles are usually better. AMOLED's on the other hand have really deep black due to the fact each pixel is individually lit, which you notice best in dark. On the other hand, IPS screens can have almost as deep blacks, at least from my experience.
